source_excerpts.text:
GENERAL ENVELOPE / LOCAL-DUAL INTERFACE
2026-10-09. Scoped internal derivation; no novelty or external validation claim.
Earlier frozen reports and source trees are preserved.

1. PURE ENVELOPE

For Hermitian Ai on C^d, f(psi)=sum_i <Ai>_psi^2, L=sum_i Ai^2,
V=tau(L), tau=Tr/d, and
k=max_{sum_y py pi_y=I/d} sum_y py f(pi_y), the exact envelope dual is

 k=min_G tau(G), subject to <psi|G|psi>>=f(psi) for every pure psi.   (I1)

One common pure ensemble is required. The feasible envelope G is PSD,
because f>=0. G=L is feasible by variance positivity. The feasible set
with trace bounded by Tr(L) is compact and closed, so a minimizer exists.
Equality of the two problems follows from compact moment duality, or
from a supergradient of the finite concave roof of f at the interior
state I/d. Thus an exact optimum G has tau(G)=k. G need not be unique.

2. THREE TRACIAL MARGINALS: NECESSARY AND SUFFICIENT LOCAL DUAL

Set W=sum_i Ai^T(A)(Ai(B)+Ai(C)). The stronger, all-tracial-state problem is

 h(W)=max_{R>=0, R_A=R_B=R_C=I/d} Tr(RW)
     =min_{X,Y Hermitian} tau(X+2Y)
       subject to X_A^T+Y_B+Y_C-W>=0.                            (I2)

Output exchange permits equal B,C dual variables Y. The full-rank
product state is strictly feasible for the primal, and a large scalar
local dual is strictly feasible. Finite-dimensional SDP strong duality
therefore applies; the local-dual interface is exact for this stronger
three-marginal problem. Neither X nor Y must be positive individually.

For C>0, V-k<=C(V-s) follows from any such local dual with

 tau(X+2Y)<=2[(1-1/C)V+k/C],                                      (I3)

because legal equal-output Choi states have Tr(RW)=2s. For C=2 the
budget is V+k. A proof of (I2) within that budget is stronger than the
original legal-channel gate: no pair self-adjointness is then required.
Failure of a restricted dual ansatz is not failure of this SDP or gate.

3. SCALAR ALLOCATION IS A RESTRICTED ANSATZ

With K=L+G_opt, a natural trial is

 D_alpha=alpha K_A^T+(1-alpha)(K_B+K_C)/2-W.                       (I4)

Its trace budget is exactly V+k for every real alpha. It need not be
positive. Frame-dependent alpha and a non-diagonal optimal G are allowed
when testing whether this ansatz might be general.

If a smooth two-sided family has D_alpha(0)>=0 with kernel E, positivity
for both signs of an infinitesimal perturbation forces
P_E D_alpha'

EXACT GENERAL GATE AND PRESERVED FAILED EXTENSIONS
2026-10-09. Universal finite C and sharp C=2 remain UNKNOWN.

ALL-FRAME FORM OF THE EXACT TARGET
Let tau=Tr/d and H_0 be the real traceless Hermitian HS space. For any
positive frame operator Q=sum_i |A_i><A_i| with A_i in H_0, put
  V(Q)=sum_i tau(A_i^2),
  s_Phi(Q)=sum_i tau[A_i Phi(A_i)],
  k(Q)=max_{sum_y p_y pi_y=I/d} sum_y p_y sum_i [Tr(pi_y A_i)]^2,
where pi_y are pure density matrices. Finite ensembles suffice by first-
and second-moment Caratheodory. k(Q) is the exact canonical support; it
does not mean a finite chosen seed hull or a PPT relaxation.

Canonical maps form a compact convex set, and all maps fix I. Cone
separation shows that a ONE-channel full-domain factor C comparator
exists for each Phi exactly when for EVERY positive Q
  V(Q)-k(Q)<=C[V(Q)-s_Phi(Q)].                       (G1)
The optimizing ensemble may depend on Q before separation, but the final
channel cannot depend on the requested observable. CANONICAL_REDUCTION.txt
shows that arbitrary TP EB comparators have the same support for this
full-domain problem. Thus canonical versus arbitrary EB is not the
remaining obstruction.

For the conjecturally sharp C=2, the missing inequality is
  2s_Phi(Q)<=V(Q)+k(Q)                              (G2)
for arbitrary Q and legal Phi. Let R be the normalized Choi state of the
supplied broadcaster, symmetrized on B,C. Then R>=0, Tr R=1, all three
single-register marginals are I/d, and its AB marginal is the Choi state
of an HS-self-adjoint channel. Writing
  W(Q)=sum_i (A_i)^T tensor (A_i^B+A_i^C),
we have Tr[R W(Q)]=2s_Phi(Q). The exact general star obligation is
  max_{R with those legal constraints} Tr[R W(Q)]<=V(Q)+k(Q).       (G3)
This is not an unrestricted operator-norm bound. The fixed tracial
marginals and Choi self-adjointness constraints are part of the target.

WHAT THE CLIFFORD MECHANISM CHANGES
For a Clifford span, all attainable expectation vectors lie in a unit
Euclidean ball; every direction has a reference-preserving spectral
ensemble. Therefore k(Q)=lambda_max(Q), V(Q)=Tr Q. Orthogonal changes of
frame preserve the Clifford relations. The weighted star lemma proves
||W(Q)||<=Tr Q+lambda_max(Q), stronger than (G3), and yields an explicit
single covariance S=(2T-I)_+ with a feasible canonical ensemble. For
arbitrary observable spaces these three facts fail: the expectation body
